messages.subject: Falcon - COMPLETED
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Tom,

Project Falcon has completed. SPA executed by all four sellers and by Bracken; completion payment of £22.9m sent to Castle & Vane's client account and £1.5m to escrow, both confirmed received. Stock transfers, certificates and statutory books received; resignations of Geoffrey and Margaret Greaves accepted; Daniel Greaves stays on as MD. 

Post-completion to-do: stamp the transfers and pay SDRT within 30 days, Companies House filings (AP01/TM01/PSC), and Completion Accounts within 45 business days. Well done all.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Corporate
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ

messages.plaintextBody:
Mark, Richard,

Delighted to confirm that Project Falcon completed this afternoon. Greaves Precision is now a wholly-owned subsidiary of Bracken Group. We'll attend to stamping and the post-completion filings and will circulate a completion bible in due course. Congratulations to the team.

Kind regards
Sarah
